summary: MacKenzie Realty Capital, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on May 15, 2026, under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose the announcement of its financial results for the fiscal third quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes a press release summarizing those results, along with forward-looking statements and risk factors. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change—is described. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation.
